end

end

source:

$$p(\theta\mid x)=\frac{p(x\mid\theta)p(\theta)}{p(x)}$$"] A -->|"$$\nabla_\theta\log p(\theta\mid x)$$"| B["Gradient step
$$\theta_{t+1}=\theta_t-\eta\nabla L(\theta_t)$$"] B --> C{"Converged?
$$\lVert\nabla L\rVert<\varepsilon$$"} C -->|No| B C -->|Yes| D(["Estimate $$\hat{\theta}$$"])

title: LaTeX sequence · formulas in messages and notes
source:
sequenceDiagram
participant A as Optimizer
participant B as Model
A->>+B: $$\theta_t$$
B-->>-A: $$\nabla_\theta L(\theta_t)$$
Note over A,B: $$\theta_{t+1}=\theta_t-\eta\nabla L(\theta_t)$$
A->>B: $$\hat{\theta}=\operatorname{argmin}_{\theta} L(\theta)$$

title: Streaming · Bayesian inference pipeline
source:
flowchart TD subgraph Input[Observations and prior] X["Observations
$$X=\{x_1,\ldots,x_n\}$$"] P["Gaussian prior
$$p(\theta)=\mathcal{N}(0,I)$$"] X --> L["Log likelihood
$$\ell(\theta)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\log p(x_i\mid\theta)$$"] P --> Q["Posterior
$$p(\theta\mid X)\propto p(X\mid\theta)p(\theta)$$"] L --> Q end subgraph Inference[Iterative inference] Q --> G["Differentiate
$$g_t=\nabla_\theta\log p(\theta_t\mid X)$$"] subgraph Newton[Second-order step] G --> H["Curvature
$$H_t=\left[\begin{matrix}a&b\\b&c\end{matrix}\right]$$"] H --> N["Regularize
$$v_t=(H_t+\lambda I)^{-1}g_t$$"] N --> S["Update
$$\theta_{t+1}=\theta_t+\eta g_t$$"] end G -.-> S S --> C{"Converged?
$$\lVert g_t\rVert<\varepsilon$$"} C -->|No| G end subgraph Validation[Validation and delivery] C -->|Yes| U["Uncertainty
$$\sigma=\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(\theta\mid X)}$$"] U --> E["Evidence
$$Z=\int p(X\mid\theta)p(\theta)\,d\theta$$"] E --> V{Checks pass?} V -->|Pass| O["Predictive
$$p(y\mid X)=\int p(y\mid\theta)p(\theta\mid X)\,d\theta$$"] V -->|Retry| G O --> R([Publish estimate]) end classDef focus fill:#e6f0ff,color:#172b4d,stroke:#3478f6,stroke-width:2px class Q,S,O focus %% The full source, including LaTeX, is identical in all three panes.
note: Nested groups, math in labels, decisions, feedback, styles. Shared 12-second source feed.
